svg.title: System architecture - three adapter levels
svg.desc: Three-row diagram. Each row pairs a watercolor voxel pictogram (apartment, floor, building) with a chunky data count (47,156 apartments, 13,806 floors, 3,183 buildings) and a horizontal "imitation" arrow pointing into an adapter card on the right (Adapter 1 - apartment layouts, Adapter 2 - floor layouts, Adapter 3 - building layouts). The three cards are wrapped in two nested dashed containers: an inner one around Adapters 1 and 2, an outer one around all three. Two vertical "transfer" arrows connect the adapter cards top-to-bottom.
